name: Halmont Properties Corporation
summary: Halmont Properties Corporation invests in real assets in Canada. The company's property portfolio includes commercial, forest, and residential properties. It also invests in securities of companies holding property, and energy and infrastructure assets. As of December 31, 2019, the company holds an interest in four heritage commercial buildings, and the ground and second floor premises of a residential condominium complex located in the Toronto Entertainment District. It also holds a 40% equity interest in Haliburton Forest; and a 60% interest in the redevelopment of the peripheral lands of the Muskoka Grandview Resort in Huntsville, Ontario. The company was formerly known as H.A.L. Concepts, Ltd. and changed its name to Halmont Properties Corporation in February 2007. Halmont Properties Corporation was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
